title: SQL Mission 3: EXISTS Instead Of JOIN For Presence

initialState.content:
-- PROBLEM: This JOIN gives duplicates
-- (one row per order, not one row per customer)
--
-- Rewrite using EXISTS for a clean presence check.
--
-- Rules:
--   1. Use EXISTS with a correlated subquery
--   2. Return customer_id and name
--   3. One row per customer who has orders
--
-- Tables:
--   customers(customer_id, name, email, region)
--   orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status, total_amount)

SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.name
FROM customers c
WHERE EXISTS (
  -- TODO: correlated subquery checking orders
)
ORDER BY c.customer_id;
